display_information.name: Uprali
display_information.description: Business decisions with sourced numbers, a human sign-off and proof on NEAR.
display_information.long_description: Mention @uprali-mvp, message it, or type /uprali with a business decision: build vs buy, a new product, a go-to-market expansion or an AI investment. Uprali works out the 3-year result, shows where every number came from and who owns it, marks its own estimates as suggestions to verify, asks for the numbers only a person can give, and records the approved decision's fingerprint on NEAR testnet so anyone can check it later. It runs on private AI (NEAR AI Cloud) when configured.

slash_commands.description: A business decision, costed over 3 years with sources
slash_commands.usage_hint: Should we build our own CRM or keep paying $720 a year for HubSpot?
